# Luxury Fintec Theme

[GitHub Download Link](https://github.com/EvobyteDigitalBiology/st-styled/blob/main/src/st_yled/themes/luxury_fintec/config.toml)

![Luxury Fintec Theme Preview Placeholder](https://evo-byte.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/luxury_fintec.png)

Luxury Fintec is a premium finance-inspired theme with elegant typography and restrained contrast.

## Highlights

- Gold-inspired accent tones for premium actions
- Clean light and dark surfaces for dashboards
- Suitable for finance, enterprise, and analytics products
